snippet.title: Orbitals – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Orbitals is coming exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 on Sept 3, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/orbitals-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Join forces with a friend to bravely navigate this wild co-op, retro anime adventure together! You'll step into the shoes of the daring duo, Maki and Omura, as they journey through space. Will you be able to save their home?

#NintendoDirect #Orbitals #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
